summary.zh: 搜索 RollingGo 酒店、查看房型与订单、创建待支付订单与取消订单
summary.en: Search RollingGo hotels, view rooms and orders, create or cancel a booking

description.zh: 连接 RollingGo 后，在对话里按预算、距离、标签和品牌筛选酒店，查看实时房型、创建待支付订单、查订单与取消订单；结果以卡片展示，支付在 RollingGo 官方页面完成。插件页管理服务安装、更新与登录，不需要 API Key。
description.en: Connect RollingGo to filter hotels by budget, distance, tags and brand, view live rooms, create a pending booking, check orders and cancel a booking from chat. Results appear as cards; payment happens on the official RollingGo page. The plugin page manages installation, updates and sign-in, with no API key.
